description: This file implements a storage utility class 'KV' for handling encrypted data storage using react-native-mmkv-storage, including methods for reading, writing, removing, and retrieving keys, as well as exporting a storage interface with cryptographic functions.

classes.name: KV
classes.description: A class providing methods for encrypted key-value storage operations using MMKV.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a value associated with a key, parsing JSON if possible.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores a value under a specified key, serializing to JSON if necessary.

methods.name: readMulti
methods.description: Reads multiple keys and returns their associated values.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from storage.

methods.name: getAllKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys, excluding internal index keys.

methods.name: writeMulti
methods.description: Stores multiple key-value pairs at once.
